text:
nora: heads up - user on Vite + Cloudflare edge saw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'createClient')`. stack trace points to .default. anyone seen this pattern?

li: yep. Vite/esbuild can treat packages as ESM and expect a default export. if our published package ends up exposing a CJS shape at runtime, imports fail.

docs-bot: existing interop doc is thin. we should add a tiny troubleshooting snippet and tsconfig example.

nora: what's the minimal snippet we can recommend? want to avoid runtime hacks in sample apps.

li: recommend two options: 1) JS quick fix: `import * as Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` then `const client = (Redwood.default||Redwood).createClient()` 2) TS recommended: set `esModuleInterop:true` + `allowSyntheticDefaultImports:true` then `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'`. add both to docs.

infra-bot: Note: I'll add a CI smoke test that bundles quickstart with esbuild to catch regressions.

nora: great. i'll open docs PR and link repro. keep examples tiny.
